caption: The drawing depicts a single dark blue glass pitcher with a stopper. The pitcher features a rounded body that narrows at the neck and then flares slightly at the mouth. A prominent curved handle is attached from the neck down to roughly the middle of the pitcher, with a wavy decorative element connecting the handle to the lower half of the pitcher. The stopper at the top is spherical. The vessel is rendered in shades of deep blue and purple, with highlights suggesting a glossy, reflective surface. The background is plain and off-white, and there is a faint ruled line below the pitcher, along with the name "JOHN DANA" written in the bottom right corner. The composition is centered, and the pitcher is the only object in the drawing.
title: Cruet
